----------------------------------------
PETE'S QUESTION: IS VISTAMATIONS-MUSIC A PROJECT, WORKSPACE, OR WHAT?
----------------------------------------

ANSWER: C:\vistamations-music is a git repository (remote: github.com/petehops89-jpg/command_control) and the VS Code workspace root folder. No .code-workspace file existed — VS Code treated it as a plain folder, which caused Cloudflare and GCP extensions to show "Open Folder" prompts instead of activating.

There are three Cloudflare Worker configs in the system:
  - cloudflare/wrangler.toml (vistamations-agent-memory — D1 + agent memory API)
  - mya/wrangler.toml (mya-vistamations — wizard + chat at /mya)
  - vistamations-home-bento/wrangler.jsonc (vistamations-webworker — homepage)

One GCP project: vists-498322 (Vertex AI, Gemini 2.5 Pro, ADC auth configured).

----------------------------------------
PETE'S DEMAND: ALIGN VS CODE TERMS TO SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE
----------------------------------------

Pete was frustrated by inconsistent terminology (project, workspace, repo, branch, directory) being thrown around. He defined his system architecture as:

    Vistamations System (C:\vistamations-music)
    ├── Local Sub-System (Docker + Windows)
    └── Cloud Sub-System (Cloudflare + Google Cloud)

With 3 environments:
    1. Local Environment (Windows/Docker)
    2. Cloudflare Environment (Edge — Workers, D1, KV)
    3. Google Cloud Environment (Vertex AI)

A terminology bridge table was created mapping Vistamations terms ↔ industry terms:

| Vistamations Term | Industry Term | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| System | Repository / Workspace folder | C:\vistamations-music — everything |
| Local Sub-System | Local environment | Docker + Windows on this PC |
| Cloud Sub-System | Cloud infrastructure | Cloudflare + Google Cloud |
| Environment | Environment / Runtime | Local, Cloudflare, GCloud |
| System root | Workspace root / Repo root | C:\vistamations-music |
| Agent mode file | System prompt | .kilo/modes/gordon.md |
| Agent persona | Agent config | personas/big-brother.json |
| Docker stack | Containerized services | 4 containers: nginx, app, Redis, Prometheus |
| Git branch | Working branch | evidence-registry (all work lives here) |
| Git commit | Snapshot / Changeset | A saved checkpoint |
| Scheduled task | Cron job | Windows Task Scheduler entry |
| API endpoint | Route / HTTP handler | GET /health etc. |
| 4-value ID | Namespaced identifier | vista-{subsystem}-{environment}-{item} |
| Command Control | Dashboard | index.html bento grid |
| Command Portal | Message queue UI | command-portal.html |
| Kilo | AI CLI tool | The AI managing the system |
| OpenClaw | Gateway | Port 18789 external connector |
| MCP | Tool protocol | n8n, Figma connections |
| Status Dot | Health indicator | Green/red dot on Command Control |

The bridge table was added to both README.md and AGENTS.md so all 10 agents reference the same terminology.

----------------------------------------
PETE'S QUESTION: WHAT IS EVIDENCE-REGISTRY? I NEVER SET THIS UP
----------------------------------------

Pete was unaware of the evidence-registry branch. He had only mentioned "evidence-based" in a chat session and never named or created this branch.

GIT EVIDENCE:
  - Branch "evidence-registry" was auto-created by the Vistamations-GitCommit scheduled task on 2026-08-09 02:08 AEST (commit 46fe1ef).
  - The name came from the title of the first session's commit: "Evidence Registry v2: VM-series research capture pipeline" (56dcf3b).
  - "main" branch contains only the initial commit (1a44669, "Initial commit") from 2026-08-07. It is 19 commits behind and effectively dead.
  - ALL system files, features, and work since 2026-08-07 are on evidence-registry:
    * Command Control Rollout
    * Olivia Gate + Dispatch
    * Command Portal
    * Media Centre (8-agent grid)
    * Mya v2 (Fortnite AI + wizard)
    * Cloudflare D1 + Workers
    * 4-value ID reorganization
    * vista-sec-water (API key vault)
    * Handy Mail 8-step gate
    * All agent mode files and personas

PETE'S MISCONCEPTION CLARIFICATION:
  - The branch is NOT a separate directory, system, or environment.
  - It IS the SAME directory (C:\vistamations-music) with git commit history on a named line.
  - Switch to "main" and you lose everything.
  - The branch name "evidence-registry" has no relationship to what actually lives on it.

This was documented in pete-clarify.txt with full git log evidence.

VS CODE WORKSPACE FILE
----------------------------------------

Created vistamations-system.code-workspace at C:\vistamations-music\ to:
  1. Register all 4 folders (system root + 3 Cloudflare Worker directories)
  2. Point Cloudflare extensions at wrangler.toml
  3. Configure GCP Cloud Code to recognize the project
  4. Eliminate "Open Folder" prompts from extensions

Folders in workspace:
  - Vistamations System (local) → root
  - Cloud Sub-System — Worker: vistamations-agent-memory → cloudflare/
  - Cloud Sub-System — Worker: mya → mya/
  - Cloud Sub-System — Worker: vistamations-home-bento → vistamations-home-bento/

To activate: File → Open Workspace from File... → vistamations-system.code-workspace
